title: Panthers starters Taylor Moton, Jaycee Horn to start training camp on NFI list
content:
The Carolina Panthers announced that right tackle Taylor Moton and cornerback Jaycee Horn will start on NFI (non-football injury/illness) list.

Moton was diagnosed with a blood clot in his lung in late June and is expected to miss the start of the regular season. Horn needed stitches after cutting his foot while running and should return early in camp.

The story will be updated
